hooks.text: Quebec Bridge staff measured a growing bend. Two days later, it fell.
What did a growing bend mean for the Quebec Bridge?
The commission doubted the bridge could be saved. Lives might have been.

title: Could Quebec Bridge Workers Have Been Saved? ⚠️
description: Quebec Bridge staff measured a growing bend before the 1907 collapse. The Royal Commission did not believe the bridge could be saved after August 27, but said better judgment might have prevented the loss of life.
